invariants.rationale: The method always returns an Array<FileHandle> (the 'images' array), which is non-null due to its initialization.
A method operating on root would throw a NullPointerException if root were null, so it is assumed non-null at exit.
tideFile is used to construct FileHandle objects, so it must be non-null.
The size of a newly created Array<FileHandle> is always zero or positive after possibly adding elements.
An image FileHandle is added to the result for each TileSheet element, so the counts match.
